{"question": "Did John and James study together? Give reasons with original text. ", "similar_sentence": ["D15:17-1:James:We can do this together!", "D22:18-1:John:Your friendship really means a lot. I'm going through some difficult times now and it's really good to know I've got someone like you.", "D21:14-2:John:I don't mind meeting up, but why Starbucks? Maybe we can have a beer somewhere?", "D22:11-1:James:Wow, John! Cool seeing others learn with your help. What kind of programs are they making?", "D10:12-1:John:I agree. We still had some money left after helping the shelter, and we decided to use this money to buy groceries and cook some food for the homeless. They were very happy about it.", "D22:1-3:James:Hey John! Been a while, but hope you're doing well. My Unity strategy game is finally finished—it took loads of time and effort, but I'm really proud. Your support and encouragement made a real difference. Thanks for believing in me! and shared a photography of a screenshot of a stone building with a giant creature", "D7:10-1:James:What's been going on? Is there anything you want to talk about? I'm here for you.", "D2:14-1:John:Show me what you've got! What is it?", "D21:5-1:James:Regarding your siblings, are you already working on anything cool with them?", "D13:11-1:John:I completely agree! By the way, did you watch the Liverpool vs Chelsea match?", "D26:8-2:James:I'm sure it will lead to great things. You got this! Oh, and I got this cool video card last week - I'm so excited to jump into it again! and shared a photo of a computer case with a red light on it", "D7:20-1:James:No problem John. Glad to help. You got this. Keep going and you'll find the answer.", "D26:13-2:John:No worries, James! Hope you have a blast playing. Let me know what you think!", "D30:3-2:James:That's great news. What did you do?", "D22:3-1:James:I appreciate your support. Check out this screenshot from it. and shared a photo of a video game screen showing a person on a horse", "D3:21-1:John:Definitely! Trying new genres is always exciting. I can't wait to hear about your journey with them. Please let me know how it goes!", "D2:9-3:James:Lately, I've been checking out different styles of it. It's been fun to try something fresh and test myself in other ways. What about you, John? Any new hobbies recently?", "D3:22-1:James:Got it, John! I'll keep you updated on my gaming adventures with the new genres. Have a good day!", "D2:8-2:John:Gotcha. Gaming can be a great way to take a break and escape for a while. Anything new you've been into lately?", "D11:18-1:James:I'm here for you. Good luck!", "D26:4-2:James:Wow, John! Mentoring programmers to make games sounds awesome! You must love it. How do you feel about starting this journey?", "D21:10-2:John:Wow, James, that's impressive! It's gonna be awesome. Can't wait to see what you come up with!", "D21:15-1:James:Well, how about we go to McGee's pub then? I heard they serve a great stout there!", "D13:9-1:John:Cool! Did you choose this course because you love football?", "D22:13-1:James:Wow! It's inspiring how fast they learn and the good time they're having. I bet they'll be creating their own complex projects soon!", "D24:13-3:John:Cool! I'm into electronic and rock music. I used to play drums when I was younger, but haven't in a while. Do you play any instruments?", "D15:18-1:John:Thanks, James. Your support means a lot to me. I'm determined to make a positive impact.", "D26:6-2:James:It's so rewarding to see how much joy you get from it. Keep going, you're doing great!", "D24:1-4:John:Hey James! Long time no see! A lot's changed since we talked. I started getting into board games. I tried one last week and it turned out to be a lot of fun. What's new with you? and shared a photo of a table with a laptop and a game on it", "D24:21-1:John:I'll keep my fingers crossed for you! You will definitely succeed, I look forward to the details!", "D19:2-1:James:Hey John! Nice to hear from you! Glad our chat made an impact. What sort of games are you interested in exploring?", "D8:35-1:James:I can't remember such a game. Maybe you have some other interesting games?", "D1:26-1:James:I'll be looking forward to it. By the way, yesterday I went bowling and got 2 strikes. I love bowling!", "D1:13-2:John:Aww, they're adorable! What are the names of your pets? And what are your plans for the app?", "D3:5-2:John:I've been playing for a month now, it's been tough but fun. How about you, how's it going?", "D2:11-2:James:Interesting, John! Sounds like an awesome immersive experience. Already found something interesting?", "D24:16-1:James:Cool! Have you ever been in a band or just jammed with friends?", "D28:2-1:John:Hey James! I'm excited to catch up. What's been up lately?", "D19:4-1:James:That's great, John! Trying out different genres can really add to your gaming experiences. Have you come across any standout games?", "D3:14-1:James:Nice one, John! Learning from experienced gamers can really help you level up your skills. Keep it up!", "D21:13-1:James:Yes, we can go to Starbucks for coffee if you want. and shared a photo of a laptop computer with a colorful keyboard on a table", "D2:13-2:James:Cool, I wish you good luck in this matter! By the way, I've got something to show you.", "D25:2-1:James:Hey John! What new has happened in your life?", "D13:20-1:James:Sure, John!", "D17:12-1:James:No worries, John! Happy to help. Just let me know if there's anything else I can assist you with.", "D27:14-2:James:Yeah, totally. You've always been there for me, John. Thanks for having my back.", "D1:11-1:John:Maybe in the future we will develop mobile applications together? Do you like the idea?", "D1:37-1:John:Agreed, James!", "D3:17-1:John:Nice one! Anything specific you're working on or upcoming challenges you're pumped about?", "D13:2-1:James:Hey John! Awesome to hear from you. Yeah, a lot has happened. Let's catch up!", "D8:11-1:James:That sounds challenging, but you're making progress. Hang in there! By the way, three days ago I bought myself an adventure book with fantasy novels and cool arts. and shared a photo of a person holding a book open to a picture of a male character", "D22:19-1:James:Just know I'm here if you need someone to talk or vent to. It might help alleviate some of the difficult times you're going through.", "D15:16-1:John:Thanks for your support! I want to make this world a better place, and with your help I will definitely achieve my goal.", "D25:14-1:James:You're really dedicated to improving and staying up to date. It's inspiring to see how you stay informed and keep learning. I also advise you to read this magazine, which is also a worthy source of information. Keep up the good work! and shared a photo of a magazine with a picture of a cartoon character", "D22:17-2:James:Yeah, you're the best! I'm here for you, no doubt.", "D4:1-1:John:Hey James! Long time no chat. What's up? Been playing any new games lately?", "D24:12-3:James:Thanks! Music is a big part of my life - nothing to do with castles though. What kind of music do you like? Do you play any instruments? and shared a photo of a desk with a laptop, headphones, and a monitor", "D25:23-1:John:I appreciate your help. Gonna make time for myself.", "D10:1-3:James:Hey John! Been a while since we chatted. Sorry 'bout not getting back sooner. How's it going? Any new games you're into?", "D11:1-1:John:Hey James, it's been a bit since we last talked. Something cool happened recently - I volunteered my programming skills for a social cause. It was cool to use my passion to do something good. I made a software tool for one charitable foundation which helped streamline their operations and make them run more smoothly. Seeing my skills making a real difference in the world was really rewarding.", "D13:1-1:John:Hey James, long time no talk! A lot has happened during this time. Let me fill you in.", "D26:1-1:John:Hey James! Busy few weeks for sure, but I'm pushing through. Got an email about a volunteer gig at a game dev non-profit. It's something I've wanted to do for a while, and could be the perfect start to a career that combines my two loves - gaming and helping. So stoked!", "D24:5-1:John:Wow, dreams have inspired you? That's interesting. Have any specific dreams guided your ideas?", "D13:13-1:John:It looks like you really root for this team!", "D21:18-2:John:Great, then I agree! See you tomorrow at McGee's Pub!", "D26:14-1:James:Cool, John. Will do! Take care, see ya!", "D3:1-1:John:Hey James, long time no see! I had a big win in my game last week - finally advanced to the next level! It was a huge confidence booster and felt like I'd really achieved something.", "D2:1-1:James:Hey John, something awesome happened since we talked. I made a game avatar and joined a new platform. It's so fun exploring and chatting with other gamers - it's a whole new adventure every time! I feel like I'm part of a super cool online community.", "D14:1-1:James:Hey John, how's it going? A lot has happened for me lately, some good and some not so great. I`m lucky to have at least two people who always help me out when I'm struggling. What about you? and shared a photo of a dog laying on a person on a couch", "D22:10-1:John:Awesome that you learned those lessons! Collaboration and feedback make a huge impact on any project. I've been teaching my siblings coding. It's been a fulfilling experience and they're already creating their own programs - amazing!", "D25:8-2:James:Way to go, John! Congrats on achieving that major career milestone. Could you tell me more about it? Why didn’t you say before that you were creating a mobile game?", "D25:3-4:John:Yesterday I started a new startup - portable smokers. Now, I’ve already welded one from metal. What other resources do you use to improve your game? Tell me about your gaming tips!", "D14:34-1:John:No problem, always here to have your back. I'm sure you'll find one that's perfect for you in making a difference.", "D25:17-2:John:Yeah, that magazine looks great! Have you also found it to be a good resource?", "D1:1-2:John:Hey! Glad to finally talk to you. I want to ask you, what motivates you?", "D10:2-4:John:Hey James! No worries, I know you are really busy at work. I'm good, thanks for asking. Oh, I've been organizing something with my friends yesterday - it was cool! Guess what it was, I'll give you a little hint. and shared a photo of a wooden table with a game controller on it", "D4:11-1:John:How cool is this! What advice do you remember most?"]}
